description: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/identity.rs destroy loop (line ~270): iterates destroy_arr directly without a prior non-string check. The 'None => continue' arm is never executed because there is no pre-validation. Contrast with mailbox.rs which validates 'if let Some(bad) = destroy_ids.iter().find(|v| !v.is_string())' and returns an error for the whole request, and submission.rs which does the same. identity.rs silently skips non-string elements instead of rejecting them. The fix is either to add the same early-return guard (consistent with mailbox.rs/submission.rs), or document why silent skip is intentional. Either way the None => continue arm is currently never reached.
title: identity.rs destroy loop: match id_val.as_str() with None => continue is unreachable dead code
